frozen_before: any D+1 or D+2 regular-session return (open to close, or open to next close) was computed for the 872 events in log/2026-10-16/init7-short-fade/events.json.gz. The daily bars holding those prices are already cached (daily-raw.json.gz); prior tests used only the D+1 official open (exit_open) and the 04:30 quote. No new fetch.
purpose: Initiative 7, first candidate after every live AH->PM long variant failed (Oct 15-19). The overnight fade is already priced into the D+1 open; test whether a long bought at that open, in the liquid regular session where Alpaca fills are realistic, makes money on the same event set.
origin: Scan-time events fade about 4.7% mid to mid by the D+1 open (short-fade census). Open question: do the names keep fading through D+1 or rebound after the open dump.
window: events D from 2024-10-01 to 2025-09-30 (the 872 scored short-fade events; D+1 = 'next')
universe: the 872 events as stored; D+2 = next calendar session after D+1 with a 16:00 close
entry: buy at D+1 official raw open x (1 + 50 bps)

exits.close1: sell at D+1 official raw close x (1 - 50 bps)
exits.close2: sell at D+2 official raw close x (1 - 50 bps)

unit: net return per trade = exit / entry - 1; equal weight; events with a missing D+1 or D+2 daily bar, or a split between D and the exit day (raw/split close ratio change > 1%), dropped and counted

subsets.gap_up: D+1 open > D close (still gapped up at the open)

statistics.interval: lc.summary: bootstrap over event dates, 4000 draws, seed 13, two-sided tail 0.025/4 (Bonferroni over 4 cells)
statistics.pass: mean > 0 AND interval lower bound > 0 AND both chronological halves > 0, at base cost; also report stress (-100 bps per trade) and gross open-to-close

descriptive_only: ETB subset; by D+1 gap (open/D close: <0, 0-20%, 20-50%, >50%); by AH move at scan; short mirror (not executable on Alpaca for non-ETB names). None can rescue a failed pass.
hypothesis: fails in all four cells: day-after micro-cap runners keep fading through the regular session, so the long side loses again; gap_up loses more than all.
decision_if_pass: the passing cell becomes a log-only shadow pulse (record the D+1 open buy and close sell for each scan event) for 15 sessions before any pilot; no live rule change.
decision_if_fail: the D+1 regular-session long lane is closed for these events; the micro-cap long side has then failed at every horizon from the scan to D+2; add that to the stop-or-replace ask.
limits: official open/close prints stand in for fills; 50 bps covers spread plus slippage at the open auction for typical names but understates it for the widest books; ETB is today's flag; no intraday stop or target; survivorship limited to assets Alpaca still lists.
